name: 06-revision-histories
caption: Replay of frozen 2024 edit histories. (a) 95% bootstrap intervals over pages; an arrow marks one that reaches zero. (b) Requests per schedule in parentheses; the last row moves the hash-only page from the ends to the center. Every red increment crossed a hidden change.
method: Trace-driven replay on complete frozen revision metadata. Panel a: preregistered measurement M1 (protocol.json), exact counts with a page-clustered bootstrap (2,000 resamples, seed 7); an interval whose lower end is zero is drawn to the axis and ends in an arrow. Panel b: post hoc addenda (protocol-addendum.json, protocol-addendum-2.json) on the preregistered draws, eight vital pages, request starts 1 h apart; the continuity, claim and existence checks of the second addendum are in plot-data.csv.
typesetting: Drawn in PGFPlots and TikZ (figure.tex, generated by plot.py; shared colours and type sizes in figstyle.tex) and typeset by XeLaTeX in the acmart typefaces Linux Libertine O and Libertinus Math (fonts/) at the acmart sigconf column width of 241.15 pt, so the paper includes it unscaled and its text matches the body. Text 7-8 pt; sub- and superscripts 6 pt; fonts embedded as CFF subsets.
layout: panel a: log-log lines with page-clustered intervals and endpoint labels; panel b: dot-and-segment chart of issued certificates (of 4,000 runs) per schedule, with the increments between schedules
encoding: red: content hashes (a reusable field); blue: revision IDs (a sound field); diamond: one hash-only page read once at the center
